title: AuditHub — Same Path, Different Verb
objective: The audit log is admin-only and you are not an admin. Read it anyway.

verifier.condition: The audit log is returned to a non-admin session through a request method other than GET.

weakness: The admin-only check is attached to GET requests only, so the same resource is reachable through another HTTP method that is never checked.
seededData: Users alice (user) and an admin account; six synthetic audit entries. In-memory.
hints: Read the API reference page. Which methods does the audit log endpoint accept?
A 403 tells you about the request you sent, not about every request that could reach the same code.
burpNotes: Send the denied request to Repeater and experiment with what else the API reference says this resource accepts.
